grid-client.signin.title: Sign in to a wisp Grid
grid-client.waiting.title: Approve it in your browser
grid-client.waiting.description: The grid's page asks for this code. wisp goes on by itself once you approve it.
grid-client.computer.title: This computer on the grid
grid-client.computer.off: Off: turn it on to reach this wisp from any browser or your phone, with no SSH and no open ports
grid-client.note: A cloud computer shows up under Machines and in Run on, like any other computer. It sleeps when nothing’s going on (watching it from here doesn’t keep it up), and wakes when you send it something or a schedule is due.
grid-client.shares.title: My shares
grid-client.shares.description: What you've shared through wisp Cloud. A stopped link no longer opens, for anyone.
grid-client.shares.none: Nothing shared yet. Share a task, a setup or an app and it shows here.
grid-client.shares.revoked: Stopped: the link no longer opens
grid-client.shares.stopped: Stopped sharing {title}: the link no longer opens
grid-client.signin.description.pre: Your own wisp on a server: tasks keep going when this computer sleeps, and you reach them from any browser or the phone app. A grid is yours (
grid-client.signin.description.post: ), your team’s, or a hosted one.
grid-client.pane.lede: Your wisp on a server: it keeps working while this computer sleeps.
grid-client.reach.title: Reach this computer from anywhere
grid-client.reach.description: Sign in to a wisp Grid with GitHub or Google, here and on your phone or other computers: they find each other through it. No SSH, no Tailscale, no open ports. You get a cloud computer there too, which works while this one sleeps.
grid-client.here.title: This computer
grid-client.keys.title: API keys
grid-client.keys.description: A key lets a script do anything you can do in your cloud wisp. Keep it like a password, and revoke it if it leaks.
grid-client.keys.nameLong: Keep a key’s name to 60 characters.
grid-client.keys.none: No keys yet. Make one per script, so you can revoke one and keep the rest.
grid-client.keys.try: Try it, with the key in $WISP_KEY:
grid-client.keys.revoke.detail: Anything using this key stops working right away. This can’t be undone.
grid-client.keys.once: Copy it now. You won’t see it again.
grid-client.accounts.title: Accounts
grid-client.accounts.description: Shares, sandboxes, API keys and this computer go through the current one. Every account's cloud computer is under Machines.
grid-client.account.signOut.detail: Its tasks stay on the grid; sign in again to see them. Its cloud computer and other computers leave Machines.
grid-client.add.description: Another grid, or another account on one you already use. You choose the account in the browser: if it signs you in as someone else, pick Use another account there.
